senses.gloss: f. (פקר; v. אַפִּיקוֹרוֹס) making free, irreverence, contempt of the Law and its teachers.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 16a">M. Kat. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>לאפיק׳ לאלתר</he> for contempt of the Law excommunication is pronounced forth with (without warning).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 100a:4">Snh. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>מי מיחזי כי אפק׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. incorr. <he>נמי מיחזי כו׳</he>) does that look like showing irreverence (to one’s teacher)? <cite ref="Eruvin 63a:13">Erub. 63ᵃ</cite> same (with <he>מתחזי</he> for <cite ref="M01116"><he>מיחזי</he></cite>). [Snh. l. c. second time <he>כה״ג מיחזי א׳</he>, corr. as above.]
